messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer, and with capacity available in your shop, it sounds like this project offers an opportunity to strengthen that relationship. We value working with you on the new series and will ensure reliable, punctual payment. How can faster payment, together with the verified easing in material and energy costs, translate into your most competitive price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.44 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You link your price move directly to cash flow; it sounds like dependable payment matters as much as the agreed payment period. We acknowledge our past late payments and will honour the agreed payment schedule. How can that payment certainty, together with the verified movement in your labour cost driver, support a further price improvement for the new series?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.44 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

Hallo, I looked at the labour cost numbers you sent, and you did your homework again. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price.

Our main cost drivers remain LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, but faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. So our offer is a price of €27.44 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

We keep the 14 days payment and 28 days lead time, so let's get this signed and the machines running. We can accept your terms and await your order.

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hello! Thanks for the numbers on power and materials, we checked them and they do help a bit, so we can drop the price. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net, but faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. But our factory is super full right now, so rushing to 42 days lead time actually makes it more expensive for us.

So we can offer a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. As an alternative: if we keep the lead time at 52 days and you pay in 30 days, I can do €31.00 per piece. Let me know! Specifically, that option is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.
